Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000743": As of 2025-09-23, Lena has the Boreal team on-call shift, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000737": As of 2025-09-23, Lena holds the pager rotation for the Boreal team, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000731" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-23, page Lena for anything Boreal-related this cycle, not Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000640": As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000574" [constraint]: Per Ember team policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)

- memory_id "1000416": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000387": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000384": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000321": As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000221": The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000219" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000171" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier, notifier consumers)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
